title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

We train and manage healthcare graduates to conduct remote, telephonic patient interactions using our purpose-built software. The result: patients receive timely support, healthcare organizations extend their capacity, and you gain real clinical experience.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">THE ROLE</strong></span></h5><p><span>As a GFH Patient Outreach Specialist, you'll conduct structured phone-based interactions with patients on behalf of our partner healthcare organizations. Using our software, you'll follow evidence-informed protocols to check in on patients, complete assessments, and escalate concerns when needed, all from a quiet space of your choosing. You'll work with patients experiencing different disease states, preventative care needs, medication use, post-discharge follow-up needs, etc. All interactions are telephonic; no video, no in-person contact required. Must be based in the U.S.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Complete a minimum of 20 hours of patient outreach per week on a flexible schedule you build</span></p></li><li><p><span>Conduct structured telephonic assessments and wellness check-ins using The Grove (Grapefruit Healthâs platform)</span></p></li><li><p><span>Document interaction outcomes accurately within the platform</span></p></li><li><p><span>Escalate patient safety concerns to a licensed clinical supervisor in real time</span></p></li><li><p><span>Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times</span></p></li><li><p><span>Participate in onboarding training and ongoing check-ins</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">TRAINING & SUPERVISION</strong></span></h5><p><span>All new graduate hires complete a â¦14 day paid onboarding covering our platform, communication frameworks, and HIPAA requirements. Once active, you'll be supervised by our Clinical Leadership Team who are available during your shifts for escalations and support.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT YOU'LL GAIN</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Verifiable healthcare experience for your resume</span></p></li><li><p><span>Confidence and fluency in patient communication</span></p></li><li><p><span>Familiarity with a real clinical software used in professional settings</span></p></li><li><p><span>The satisfaction of genuinely improving patient outcomes</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>U.S. based required</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must be a healthcare school graduate â active clinical enrollment does not qualify for this role. You will be rejected if you are in school</span></p></li><li><p><span>Certification as a medical assistant, community health worker, patient navigator, pharmacy technician, or comparable clinical credential is a plus</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must have a compatible computer and cell phone with SMS</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must be able to work at least 20 hours/week</span></p></li><li><p><span>A quiet, private workspace free of background noise or distractions</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong verbal communication skills, or a genuine desire to develop them</span></p></li><li><p><span>Comfort working independently in a remote environment</span></p></li></ul><p>If you are passionate about helping others and have a knack for building relationships, we encourage you to apply!</p><p></p><h5><strong><em>Required with Submission</em></strong></h5><ul><li><p><strong><em>Two-minute or less video explaining why you would be a good fit for Grapefruit Health and why you think learning how to perform care telephonically is important to prepare you to become a clinician. title: Licensed Customer Service Representative
description:
Description Join Our Team as a Remote Experienced and Licensed Customer Service Representative! Within our Customer Response Center, the Remote Customer Service Representative provides timely, accurate and responsive information and service to policyholders and agents for a division of Personal Lines products, plans and programs. Independently solve problems relating to policies within scope and escalate others as appropriate. Identifies, analyzes, and owns customer policy needs to ensure high customer satisfaction, growth and retention of business. Training: Paid training is Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm EST (full time). Training is a critical component to your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory for success in this role. Shift: After onboarding and training is complete, go-forward shifts will have a start time between Shift hours 8:30 am -10:30 am EST with a weekend rotation. One weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) will be required with an alternate day off mid-week when working the weekend. Work Location: All equipment is provided. However, to work from home you must have dependable, wired internet connectivity with an upload speed of at least 5Mbps and a download speed of at least 25Mbps along with a quiet, secure, distraction free place to work. License: Active P&C Producers insurance license REQUIRED. We are currently not hiring in NY, CA, AK, HI, NM or IL. Qualifications Associates degree or 1+ year Insurance experience preferred. 2 years'+ related Customer Service experience is required. Ability to review, record and organize written data from a variety of sources with no prescribed format is essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. P&C Producers insurance license required. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

  • A big part of this role is making sure customers feel heard, understood and helped. We care about support that is accurate and efficient, but also warm, human and thoughtful.

What Weâre Looking ForEssential experience

You donât need to be a developer, but you should be curious about technology and comfortable investigating how things work.

  • Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar

  • Supporting customers across multiple time zones, especially APAC-friendly hours

Working Hours

This is a remote role, for people based in either the UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only). Youâll also need regular overlap with the UK team for training, collaboration and handovers.

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits.

Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role.

Your team
  • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth
  • Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week
Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?
  • Competitive salary
  • A wide range of family-friendly policies
  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day
  • Personal and professional development
About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in operations, business management, or revenue execution â with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience building, running, or scaling a business â including sales growth, client retention, and financial performance accountability.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the courage to ask tough questions, the polish to challenge constructively, and the vision to see what's possible before it's obvious.
  • Background check is required for this role

Essential Physical Skills

  • Repetitive finger motion as used in computer use.
  • Extensive work with computer screens
  • Everyday requirements of bending, grabbing, holding, and lifting light objects
  • Work on Hunger Projects requires heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs), moving objects, pushing, and pulling, bending and kneeling
  • Up to 50% travel time

title: Freelance Creative Director
description:
Freelance Creative Director

BMWL (an Axiom Advisors Group company) â Remote / Contract


About Us:

BMWL is a dynamic political consulting and public affairs firm located in the heart of the Bay Area. We specialize in providing strategic communication, advocacy, and campaign management services to a diverse range of clients, including political candidates, advocacy groups, and non-profit organizations. Our team comprises experienced professionals passionate about making a positive impact through effective communication and strategic political consulting.


BMWL is committed to creating a diverse and welcoming workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply, including people of color, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, veterans, and persons with disabilities. If you are unsure whether you meet the qualifications for this role but are still interested, we encourage you to apply.


About the Role

BMWL is seeking a freelance Creative Director to support branding and media development across our client roster. This is a flexible, project-based engagement ideal for a seasoned creative who thrives working with campaigns, advocacy groups, and public affairs clients.


What You'll Do


  • Develop creative concepts and brand identities for client campaigns, from initial strategy through final execution
  • Manage media development, including digital ads, video, print collateral, and social content
  • Draft and manage digital ad copy, either writing it directly or overseeing and QC'ing copy produced by others
  • Partner with our internal production and account teams to ensure the creative aligns with the campaign strategy and messaging
  • Present creative concepts to partners and clients, incorporating feedback through revision cycles
  • Maintain brand consistency across multi-platform deliverables
  • Stay current on political/advocacy creative trends and best practices


What We're Looking For


  • 7+ years of creative direction experience, ideally with political, advocacy, or public affairs clients
  • Strong portfolio spanning brand identity, digital media, and video/print production
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple client projects simultaneously
  • Excellent collaborator â able to take direction from partners while bringing a strong creative point of view
  • Familiarity with fast-paced campaign timelines and quick-turn deliverables a plus


Engagement Details


  • Freelance/contract basis, flexible hours
  • Remote-friendly, with availability for occasional check-ins with the BMWL/Axiom team
  • Rate: $85â$150/hour (or equivalent day/project rate), commensurate with experience. Final rate depends on scope, project complexity, and campaign timelines.

To apply, email your resume and availability for a 45-minute meeting to alisonw@bmwl.net

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member.   • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

title: Voice Over Artist
description:
We are one of the leading tech-driven media and entertainment companies, producing uplifting content in 17 languages for audiences of all ages. Known for the award-winning digital publisher boredpanda.com and the Crafty Panda DIY channel, we fight the worldâs boredom at scale - reaching 160 million site views per month and 62 billion video views per year. Our team consists of around 350 creative professionals from 36 countries, with 2 offices in Vilnius, Lithuania.

Spike, the global animated series, is searching for talented voice actors to bring its characters to life! Our YouTube channel has reached over 1 billion views, entertaining children worldwide with universal, character-driven stories. We're casting our two lead roles: Spike, an imaginative, curious, and fearless 7-year-old whose creativity turns everyday moments into adventures; and Sparkle, his confident, attention-loving 5Â½-year-old sister with unmistakable main-character energy. Additionally, we are seeking versatile utility players who can perform multiple recurring characters - from the know-it-all giraffe girl, Poem, and the scared but loyal elephant boy, Muddles, to the bully rhino twins, Storm and Thunder, and the local mad scientist lion, Professor Roar, to name a few. Plus, there are loving parents, friends, foes, and all the colorful citizens that make Spike's world so vibrant.

What You Will Do:

  • Bring recurring characters to life with expressive performances that match the show's playful and energetic tone;
  • Help shape memorable voices and personalities for the faces of a global IP;
  • Deliver engaging voice performances that support clear storytelling in fast-paced 3â5 minute episodes;
  • Perform dialogue that enhances visual comedy and elevates emotional moments;
  • Maintain consistent character voices and performances across multiple episodes;
  • Take direction well, adjusting pacing, emotion, and delivery as needed;
  • Record clean, broadcast-quality audio from a professional home studio;
  • Attend directed recording sessions via remote call, if required;
  • Work efficiently to deliver recordings on schedule as part of Spike's consistent weekly production cadence;
  • Collaborate with directors and sound supervisors to create polished, world-class voice performances for each episode.

What We Expect:

  • Professional voice acting experience in animation, games, children's media, dubbing, or similar productions;
  • Strong character acting skills with distinctive, believable, and consistent voices;
  • Strong acting instincts and an understanding of how voice performance supports visual storytelling;
  • Ability to take direction while bringing your own creative ideas to deliver the strongest performance possible;
  • Clear diction, vocal control, and emotionally authentic performances;
  • Fluency in English and mastery of American accents;
  • Spike is worldwide, so an understanding of globally accessible performances that communicate character and emotion across cultures;
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, digital-first production environment;
  • A reliable home recording setup capable of delivering broadcast-quality audio;
  • Professionalism, responsiveness, and the ability to meet deadlines while collaborating effectively with the creative team.

Compensation: 40-120 eur/gross per episode.

You will be required to work on a flexible schedule on weekdays, weekends and evenings according to range reservations/ schedules as presented by the Company Office.

You must be a self-starter, demonstrate a good work ethic and provide superior customer service. You will need to display good communication in the English Language as well as inter-personal and organizational skills. Within your duties you will be expected to interface with DND/Police/civilian range users as well as assigned subcontractors.

Scheduling

  • Reporting, recording all incidents, damages, causes and vandalism (including graffiti in the Butts)

  • Get Project Manager authority before calling in subcontractors;

  • Build/Repair target frames ensuring sufficient are on-hand at all times replacing

Facilitiesâ Housekeeping

title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. Experience & Skills

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

description:
Field Maintenance Technician â CTC-LIS

Location: Townsville, Queensland

Employment Type: Full time


About Cubic Defence

At Cubic Defence Australia, we deliver world-class training and simulation capability in support of the Australian Defence Force. Our teams help create and sustain technology solutions that support mission success, safety and readiness for those who serve.


About the Role

Reporting to the 2IC Field Services, the Field Maintenance Technician is responsible for supporting maintenance activities and ensuring the ongoing availability of Combat Training Centre â Live Instrumentation System (CTC-LIS) equipment. This hands-on role supports the preparation, deployment and maintenance of CTC-LIS Relay Stations, including diagnosis and repair of telecommunications equipment such as UHF, microwave and LTE systems, as well as basic servicing and maintenance of diesel-powered generators.


This position requires significant time deployed away from Townsville to various Australian Army and non-Defence training areas. During Force-on-Force exercise phases, you will work in a small team environment providing 24-hour maintenance coverage in the field.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections, maintenance and associated repairs of CTC-LIS instrumentation and telemetry equipment.
  • Diagnose and repair telecommunications equipment, including UHF, microwave and LTE systems.
  • Conduct pre-deployment readiness checks of telemetry and mechanical equipment.
  • Maintain CTC-LIS equipment during field deployments.
  • Service and perform minor repairs to diesel-powered generators.
  • Provide technical advice and assistance during instrumentation function checking phases.
  • Be prepared to deputise for the 2IC Field Services during periods of absence.
  • Assume a leadership role within a small team environment during field deployments when required.


About You

You are a capable and motivated technician with strong fault-finding skills, sound communication ability and the confidence to work in both field and workshop environments. You are comfortable operating in dynamic conditions, prioritising maintenance issues and clearly communicating intent and outcomes.


Background and Experience

  • Experience in the installation and maintenance of communications systems.
  • Basic knowledge and understanding of electronics and electrical principles.
  • Proven fault-finding and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify, analyse and prioritise maintenance issues.
  • Ability to work effectively in both field and workshop environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using IT systems and programs.


Conditions of Employment

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications, Electrotechnology or a comparable qualification.
  • Clean Heavy Truck Licence to drive company equipment, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Vehicle Loading Crane high risk licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Work at Heights qualification, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Forklift licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Successful completion of a National Police Check.
  • Ability to obtain and hold an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency security clearance.


Working Environment

This role requires significant time deployed in the field and flexibility to support business operations across multiple time zones. From time to time, you may be required to monitor and respond to telephone calls, emails and other necessary communications from Cubic, customers or suppliers outside ordinary working hours to support critical issues or business needs.


Compliance and General Duties

  • Comply with the role job description and Cubicâs Quality Management System.
  • Follow Cubic Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures.
  • Comply with established security policies and procedures.
  • Follow Cubic Human Resources procedures.
  • Perform other duties as requested.


Apply Now

If you are a technically skilled professional who enjoys hands-on work, problem-solving in demanding environments and supporting high-tempo military training exercises, we would welcome your application.


The description above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements.

title: Graduate Quality Officer
description:
Be part of a world-class team supporting vital Antarctic research and operations. The AIR Alliance brings together skilled professionals from Bouygues Construction Australia, The Australian Antarctic Division, Stantec and Mott MacDonald to deliver essential services in one of the most challenging and awe-inspiring environments on Earth. If youâre ready to push boundaries, work with cutting-edge projects, and make a real impact, this is your opportunity.

About The Role

The Quality Graduate supports the Alliance's quality management initiatives through quality assurance activities, compliance monitoring, audits, investigations, reporting, and continuous improvement projects. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, the role contributes to maintaining compliance with regulatory, contractual, and organisational requirements while supporting the effective operation of the Quality Management System. The Quality Graduate will assist the Quality Manager and Project Controls Manager with data analysis, auditing, risk management, and process improvement, while contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous improvement across the Alliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Compliance with Alliance quality policies and procedures.
  • Timely completion of assigned quality activities and projects.
  • Accuracy and integrity of quality data and reporting.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in document control activities, including the review and update of procedures, work instructions, and forms.
  • Maintain quality records, templates, registers, and controlled documents within the Alliance SharePoint quality management environment.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and delivery of the Alliance Internal Audit Schedule.
  • Coordinate audit logistics, track audit findings, and facilitate close-out of corrective actions.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen.
  • Support implementation and verification of quality and compliance requirements associated with the Topside Program, including readiness activities leading to January 2027 delivery milestones.
  • Support review and implementation of Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and verify supplier compliance with agreed inspection and quality requirements.
  • Assist in monitoring supplier quality performance, documentation compliance, and adherence to Alliance quality requirements.
  • Support quality risk identification, assessment, treatment tracking, and reporting in accordance with Alliance risk management processes.
  • Coordinate and maintain records of mandatory quality training and inductions, including Quality Management Plan and Risk Management induction requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Completion of a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Science, Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 or similar).
  • Awareness of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma. Knowledge of audit principles and risk management concepts.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and Power BI (desirable)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

title: TBM Technician
description:
At Bouygues Construction Australia, we are dedicated to the design, construction, and delivery of nation shaping projects across civil infrastructure, engineering, and energy and services.

We have proudly been working in Australia for more than 25 years.

Our local experience in underpinned by significant global expertise and resourcing.

About The Role

As a TBM Technician, you will be responsible for providing civil engineering support and operating the EPB Tunnel Boring Machine on the River Torrens to Darlington (T2D) project on this key civil engineering project.

The T2D project involves the construction of a 10.5-kilometre motorway, with three lanes in each direction and including tunnel sections, linking the River Torrens area in the north to Darlington in the south of Adelaide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse TBM parameters (face pressure, torque, thrust, spoil removal, etc.) to support civil engineers and ensure adherence to project timelines and compliance to safety standards and technical requirements. Â­
  • Coordinate with civil engineers, segment erectors, and conveyor personnel to maintain continuous operations according to production schedules and timelines, as well as applying appropriate procedures and selecting correct equipment.Â­
  • Continuously observing and analysing live data and adjusting parameters such as face pressure, torque, thrust, and spoil removal to ensure efficient and safe tunnelling. Â­
  • Diagnose and report technical issues to senior civil engineering staff. Â­
  • Ensuring the completed work satisfies the civil infrastructure projectsâ specifications, regulations and contract provisions. Â­
  • Organising and coordinating maintenance and repair work of the TBM equipment. Â­
  • Follow all safety regulations and environmental controls. Â­
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, tabulations and reports to assist with production planning.Â­
  • Participate in daily toolbox talks and safety briefings.
  • Ensure proper handover between shifts

Qualification & Experience

  • Relevant trade qualification or diploma. Â­
  • Significant demonstrated experience in the operation of Tunnel Boring Machines
  • 5+ years in TBM Operation
  • Strong understanding of TBM operational systems including hydraulics, electrics, and PLC interfaces
  • Ability to read and interpret tunnelling data, instrumentation, and geological reports
  • Must be safety-conscious and able to work in a team
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and rotational schedules
  • Valid certifications for confined space, working at heights, and first aid are a plus
  • Quantitative and qualitative risk assessment and monitoring of risk controls and actions involved in delivery and implementation of projects
  • Advanced skills in relevant computer software packages; Microsoft Suite; Primavera 6 etc
  • Written, verbal and presentation skills e.g. facilitating meetings, pre-starts and tool box meetings and basic cost control skills

title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
location: Los Angeles, Los Angeles, California, United States
description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.

title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

title: Business Relationship Manager (Abia)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What we do At Moniepoint we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses. About the role Location: Remote (Full-time) We are currently looking to hire a Business relationship manager, the ideal candidate will be responsible for Merchant Acquisition, developing sales strategies and identifying business growth opportunities. What you’ll get to do Engage in business development activities and solicitation of new business; Customer acquisition through sale of the bank’s products and services. Cross selling of bank products and services. Actively seeking out new sales opportunities through cold calling, networking and social media Create marketing strategies to achieve sales targets. Conducts daily meetings with the sales team and carry out reviews on the previous day and jointly plan for the week ahead Manages and maintains current business relationships Conducting market research to identify selling possibilities and evaluate customer needs Participate in market storms, community fairs and cluster marketing events e.g. Trade Fairs Implement best practices to meet customers’ needs and requirements. Prepare and deliver appropriate presentations on products and services Collaborate with team members to achieve better results Gather feedback from customers or prospects and share with internal teams Understand customer financial needs and objectives. Recommend appropriate financial product or service to the customer. To succeed in this role, we think you should have Minimum 4-5 years in-depth sales experience, preferably in the banking, fintech or similar industries. Strong understanding of the local financial services industry Experience in marketing/sales within the banking sector with emphasis on onboarding and managing Merchants. Experience selling lending services and merchant POS devices to corporates should be an added advantage (Good network of enterprise merchants) Strong business acumen and analytical thought process. Ability to execute goals independently with little or no supervision. Excellent communication skills. Tertiary education from a recognised institution. Must be resident in Abia State What we can offer you Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter An interview with the Hiring Team. An interview with a member of our Executive team.  Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: CRM Copy Writer
description: Who we are Ranked in 2023 and 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s worth in transactions monthly in the continent. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. Our in-house creative agency plays a crucial role in defining and shaping our brand across multiple touchpoints, from digital and social media to video, print, and experiential marketing. About the role Location: Remote We are looking for an experienced CRM Copywriter to craft compelling, conversion-driven messaging for our email, SMS, in-app, push notifications, and lifecycle marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate is a storyteller and strategist who understands how to write persuasive, engaging, and data-informed copy that strengthens customer relationships and drives retention. As a CRM Copywriter, you will be responsible for writing high-performing customer lifecycle communications that engage, educate, and retain Moniepoint users. You will collaborate closely with the CRM strategist, Head of CRM, and CRM Designers to develop messaging strategies for different audience segments and CRM platforms. This role will focus on enhancing engagement across all CRM touchpoints, ensuring that every message adds value and strengthens brand loyalty. What you’ll get to do; Write compelling and targeted copy for CRM channels, including email, SMS, in-app messages, and push notifications. Develop customer lifecycle messaging for onboarding, engagement, retention, and reactivation campaigns. Craft transactional and automated messages that enhance the user experience. Tailor messaging for different customer personas and user segments. Collaborate with the Head of CRM to refine messaging strategies based on performance analytics. Continuously test subject lines, CTAs, and messaging structures to improve engagement and conversion rates. Analyze open rates, click-through rates, and customer response data to refine copy effectiveness. Stay updated on email deliverability best practices, spam filters, and mobile-friendly formatting. Ensure all messaging aligns with Moniepoint’s brand voice, tone, and personality. Balance creativity with clarity, ensuring messages are engaging, informative, and action-driven. Work closely with CRM, designers, product team, and customer support teams to align messaging with overall marketing goals. Provide copy direction for visual assets in CRM campaigns. To succeed in this role, we think you should have;  3+ years of experience in CRM copywriting, email marketing, or lifecycle marketing. Growing portfolio showcasing email, SMS, and in-app messaging copy. Proven ability to write engaging, conversion-driven copy for digital customer touchpoints. Proficiency in CRM platforms Ability to balance creativity with core information to drive messaging effectiveness. Experience working in fintech, banking, or financial services will be considered a plus Familiarity with SEO best practices for email content is an advantage Key Soft Skills Creative & Strategic Thinker – Can craft engaging messaging that resonates with users. Insights-Driven Mindset – Uses results to refine copy and improve performance. Attention to Detail – Ensures CRM messages are clear, concise, and error-free. Collaboration & Adaptability – Works effectively across teams. Time Management & Multitasking – Can handle multiple campaigns and deadlines efficiently. Why Join Moniepoint? Work with a fast-growing, innovative Company that reaches millions of customers. Gain hands-on experience with a team of seasoned creative professionals. Access to mentorship, training, and career growth opportunities. Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we review the quality of your writings in your portfolio Preliminary phone call with HR: a brief conversation where your expectations are discussed, background, growth potential, career outlook, personality and cultural fit is accessed. Assessment: a take-home assessment to evaluate strategic writing skill set and technical depth Final executive conversation: an interview with the Head of CRM & Senior Copy Writer, where you will present the assessment. You will also be assessed on alignment with our values and principles. Submit your resume alongside your best writing projects. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates

title: Customer Experience Researcher
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. About this role The CX Researcher is responsible for conducting in-depth qualitative and mixed-methods research to uncover customer behaviours, motivations, needs, and pain points across Moniepoint's products and services. The role is embedded directly within a product org unit, working alongside product managers, engineers, and designers as a full member of the team. The CX Researcher translates rich customer insight into prioritized, actionable recommendations and advocates for the customer voice throughout the product development process. At the Senior Associate level, the CX Researcher independently manages complex research initiatives and may mentor junior team members. Responsibilities Research Design & Execution: Design and execute qualitative research methods including in-depth interviews (IDIs), usability testing, concept testing, ethnographic studies, diary studies, and focus groups. Lead the design and execution of complex, multi-method research projects with minimal supervision. Develop comprehensive research plans, discussion guides, screeners, and stimuli tailored to specific research questions. Recruit and manage participants for research studies, ensuring diverse and representative samples. Facilitate and moderate engaging research sessions, expertly eliciting deep insights from participants. Conduct continuous customer discovery as a standing practice — not only when studies are formally commissioned. Data Analysis & Synthesis: Analyse qualitative data using appropriate methodologies including thematic analysis, affinity mapping, and journey mapping. Synthesise findings from qualitative, quantitative, and behavioural data sources into clear, concise, and compelling outputs. Prioritise research findings using structured frameworks to distinguish critical unmet needs from performance gaps and opportunity areas. Identify key customer pain points, unmet needs, and opportunities for product improvement. Customer Satisfaction & Journey Ownership: Track and analyse customer satisfaction metrics for the product journeys owned by your org unit, identifying what is driving movement in either direction. Initiate timely root cause research when satisfaction signals indicate a problem — without waiting to be asked. Visit customer-facing touchpoints (e.g. support centres) regularly to observe real interactions and supplement digital research with field observation. Collect and synthesise feedback from commercial and relationship-facing teams in your geography. Insight Dissemination & Advocacy: Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate research insights into product development processes. Communicate research findings and actionable recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Deliver all research output as structured, prioritised insight — not unprocessed data or narrative reports. Track the status of your recommendations — which have been acted on, which have been declined, and why — and follow up accordingly. Act as a passionate advocate for the customer, ensuring their perspective is understood and considered throughout the organization. Community of Practice & Team Contribution: Contribute to the continuous improvement of research processes, methodologies, and tools within the CX Research function. Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, sharing best practices and fostering skill development. Participate actively in team knowledge sharing and contribute to building a strong research culture across the function.
